race.description: The Prince Of Merewether Conditional Hcp (Bm68)
race.comment: FETES DES MERES (15) has the right blend of recent higher-grade exposure and distance grounding to take this out. She was sent out favourite when fourth in a BM82 at Warren last start and, while beaten two and a half lengths, she now gets back into a BM68 and has already won at around 1400m. Can surprise at the big odds. LAWLESS LUCY (9) was wide without cover in a Rosehill BM72 and is unbeaten from two starts at this track. Blinkers first time give her a clear chance to rebound fourth up. JACENZA (11) missed by a nose in Open company at Warren and has a track-and-trip win, though his previous defeat has to be respected. Winning rider hops back aboard and has the speed to roll forward from the sticky gate. UNREACHABLE (8) deep into the prep and due for a change of luck. Has been beaten a head at her past two starts at this track, most recently as favourite. Respect.
